description: Verifies raw.schema.getDomains by issuing raw CDP command(s) Schema.getDomains against an about:blank page. It passes when every non-optional CDP step completes without a protocol error. Optional steps are best-effort, and returned values are not graded. The command is sent over the page-target transport. This probe is diagnostic-only because the pinned Chrome protocol no longer exposes `Schema.getDomains`.
title: raw.schema.getDomains
